notes.title: August Demo Update
notes.content:
I thank you all for your feedback on the first build of The Sword Game, I apologize for taking too long as I was dealing with a major burnout in the middle of the development. Any feedback is crucial as I still want to make The Sword Game a game that people want to play. Here are the changed made:


A brand new Level Selection screen.

A new sword swing animation: It's now a trail that appears on the screen, made using a custom trail renderer.

A new bloody kill effect applied to every enemy.

A new, more cartoonish looking stomp effect.

Added camera tilting on side movement and camera sideways turning.

The enemies now have a flashing red light around them when the player gets close enough to it, enhancing the visibility.

Controller vibration adjusted.

Main menu navigation system bugfixes.

Fixed a bug where pressing down the W key on the keyboard and resetting the level while holding it to not trigger the time counter start sequence.

Tutorials 1 and 2 adjusted for smoother playthrough (Tutorial 2's rank A requirement changed from 24 seconds to 22).
